description: The fast, small answer for a postal code. Takes a US ZIP Code, a US ZIP+4, a Canadian FSA, a Canadian postal code, or a latitude,longitude pair, and returns the code's city, state or province, county, and whether it spans more than one county. Given a ZIP+4 it also returns the street ranges making up that delivery segment; given coordinates it reverse-geocodes to the code containing the point. zip_lookup accepts exactly the same inputs and returns the same ZIP+4 detail — choose this one when the answer only needs to be the code and its place, because the payload is about half the size and only the timezone enrichment is available here. Use zip_lookup for census, demographic, district or American Community Survey enrichments.

code.description: A US ZIP Code, ZIP+4, Canadian FSA, Canadian postal code, or a latitude,longitude pair. For example 90210, 90210-1234, M5V, M5V 2T6, or 34.10,-118.41.

include.description: Enrichments to add. Only timezone is available on this tool; use zip_lookup for census, district, demographic and ACS enrichments.
